channel.title: The Grant Desk - Audio, Sound & Music, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Audio, Sound & Music, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 2 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• INHABIT #16 and #17: Artist-in-Residence 2027 (Max Planck Institute for Empirical Aesthetics)
    https://www.aesthetics.mpg.de/en/research/inhabit-artist-in-residence.html
    Max Planck Institute for Empirical Aesthetics · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Artist's fee of EUR 8,000 plus an accommodation fee of EUR 2,000, a production budget depending on the project, and travel costs to and within Frankfurt. Also included: realisation of the final project, collaborations with scientists, access to the institute's library, sound studio and scientific facilities, and curatorial support throughout the residency. No application fee.
  • CTM 2027 Research Networking Day: Open Call for Presentations (Berlin)
    https://www.ctm-festival.de/festival-2027/open-calls/research-networking-day-2027
    CTM Festival · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · No funding for travel or accommodation. Participants receive a CTM 2027 festival pass, a catered lunch on the day of presentations, and a group dinner. Entrance to the event is free; free to apply.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of Amsterdam: PhD, Protest and Political Speech in the Nordics 1930-1970 (Sound of Disagreement)
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362349/phd-position-on-protest-and-political-speech-in-the-nordics-1930-1970/
    University of Amsterdam (UvA), Faculty of Humanities, Department of European Studies · deadline Closed 20 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,059 to 3,881 gross per month at 38 hours per week, on the Dutch university PhD scale, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and 8.3 percent year-end bonus. No application fee.
  • Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung: Project Funding (October 2026 round)
    https://evs-musikstiftung.ch/en/project-funding/application/
    Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · No published minimum or maximum. Primarily covers artistic costs, not overheads. The Foundation explicitly will not fully fund a project, and requires at least one other institution to participate financially at a level similar to the amount requested, functioning as a de facto 1:1 match. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Creation and Production: Contemporary Music
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/creation-and-production-contemporary-music
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000 (depending on overall project size). No application fee.
  • Klang Copenhagen Avantgarde Music Festival: Open Call 2027, MUSIC/MOVEMENT
    https://www.klang.dk/open-calls/opencall2027
    Klang - Copenhagen Avantgarde Music Festival · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Klang aims to cover production costs and performer fees. Travel and accommodation are discussed case by case rather than guaranteed. No commission fee is offered, since the call seeks finished work rather than new creation. No application fee.
  • In Listening 2027: Call for Hybrid Radio/Live Works (CTM Festival, Berlin)
    https://www.ctm-festival.de/festival-2027/open-calls/in-listening-2027
    CTM Festival with Deutschlandfunk Kultur and ORF · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · Two selected works are each supported by a fee of EUR 6,000. CTM covers travel to Berlin and lodging during the production and festival periods; technical and staging costs for the CTM presentation (and possible ORF musikprotokoll presentation) are covered separately by arrangement. Research, creation and collaborator costs are the artist's own. Radio-production support (translations, voiceovers, studio time) can be provided by Deutschlandfunk Kultur upon discussion. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Experimental Sound Studio: Florasonic Multichannel Sound Installation 2026
    https://ess.org/open-call-florasonic-2026/
    Experimental Sound Studio (ESS), in partnership with the Lincoln Park Conservatory · deadline Closed 14 Jun 2026 · USD 1,500 artist fee per artist/team. Open worldwide, but ESS can support domestic (US) travel only. Up to 8 hours of technical support (mastering, spatialization, speaker distribution) for artists who need it. Possible additional paid live performance/activation opportunities. No application fee.
  • Experimental Sound Studio: Sonic Pavilion 2026 (24-Channel Festival)
    https://ess.org/sonic-pavilion-2026-open-call/
    Experimental Sound Studio (ESS), presented by the City of Chicago DCASE · deadline Closed 14 Jun 2026 · USD 2,000 artist fee per artist/team. Artists travel to Chicago to work on the piece; additional funds available for engagement activation partners. Limited technical support (mastering, spatialization, speaker distribution) for a small number of artists who need it. No application fee.
  • Music WorX: Music-Tech Incubator 2026 (Hamburg)
    https://kreativgesellschaft.org/en/innovation-inkubatoren/inkubatoren/music-worx/
    Hamburg Kreativ Gesellschaft (Kreativ Gesellschaft) · deadline Closed 17 Jun 2026 · EUR 3,200 development budget per team plus a EUR 1,500 per month living allowance across the 3-month programme. End-of-programme prizes: EUR 1,000 audience award and EUR 2,500 jury award. No equity is taken. No application fee.
  • ICST: Artists in Residence 2027 Open Call (ZHdK, Zurich)
    https://www.zhdk.ch/en/research/icst/icst-air/conditions-selection-process-20736
    Institute for Computer Music and Sound Technology (ICST), Zurich University of the Arts (ZHdK) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Use of ICST facilities and technical infrastructure plus technical support by research staff; per diems for meals and accommodation during the residency; travel contribution toward travel to Zurich (up to CHF 300 for persons living in Europe, up to CHF 500 for those outside Europe). Participants organise their own travel and accommodation (ICST assists if required). No application fee.
  • Q-O2: Residency Programme 2027 (Experimental Music & Sound Art)
    https://www.q-o2.be/en/in-residency/
    Q-O2 (workspace for experimental music and sound art) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · NO artist fee. International residents: shared accommodation in the Q-O2 apartment plus a travel contribution up to EUR 200. A small subsistence budget is reserved for artists who do not come with other funding. Work studio, materials and technical equipment provided. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.description:

    https://www.bcartscouncil.ca/program/media-artists/
